title: pentameris patula
intro: Pentameris patula, commonly known as Needle Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It is a herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pentameris patula include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
